description.value: Rotary Bike Park is a City of Merritt-operated outdoor cycling facility tagged as a BMX venue in OSM, located in the Nicola Valley region of BC's Okanagan & Thompson area. It sits within the broader network of Merritt's municipal parks, which also includes a bike pumptrack at nearby Central Park. The facility caters primarily to BMX and freestyle riders.
